mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate relative to its recent 12-month average compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS is declining relative to its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the housing starts series (HOUST) exceeds its 12-month moving average by more than 5%, it signals strong consumer confidence and increased disposable income, leading to higher corporate earnings expectations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST exceeds 12-month MA by 5% but SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in UNRATE and increase in PAYEMS occurs but SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of rising industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average, manufacturing output growth accelerates, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO exceeds 6-month MA but SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) relative to its 12-month average indicates robust labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 2.5% year-over-year, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% YoY but SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong aggregate demand, which increases corporate revenue expectations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in RSAFS and HOUST occurs but SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0%, the labor market is tight, leading to wage pressures and higher consumer spending, which boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE falls below 5.0% but SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of such periods.
